cohort: Singleton deliveries between 1991-2021 in a tertiary medical center (n=356,356), including 411 offspring of mothers with FMF
finding: Maternal familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) was independently associated with long-term infection-related hospitalization in offspring.
mod_finding: Maternal FMF was independently associated with preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, and low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was independently associated with maternal FMF.
